mechanism: Eplerenone (potassium-sparing diuretic) combined with propranolol (beta-blocker) increases hyperkalemia risk through aldosterone antagonism and reduced renal perfusion, while propranolol may increase eplerenone concentrations via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function regularly; consider adjusting eplerenone dose or selecting alternative beta-blocker; ensure adequate hydration and sodium intake.
